summary: Tested the Achievements feature implementation for Supervision 2.0. Backend code verified via code review and API tests. Frontend component code reviewed. Environment limitation: only 1 draft meeting available — no analysed meetings to perform full E2E test of achievements rendering.
action_items: ENVIRONMENT: No analysed meetings exist in the test environment — full E2E test of AchievementsSection rendering with real data was not possible. Consider seeding an analysed meeting with achievements data to enable full UI testing.
LOW: The draft meeting report page shows 'Loading meeting report...' indefinitely when navigated to directly — consider adding a redirect for draft-status meetings that have no analysis.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend ✅: _parse_analysis_row (review.py line 52) correctly includes 'achievements' in _ensure_list loop — ensures JSONB is always returned as list, not string.
Backend ✅: init_db.py line 134 defines 'achievements JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT []' in CREATE TABLE, line 558 has ALTER TABLE migration.
Backend ✅: processing.py lines 316-321 saves achievements via separate UPDATE after INSERT — gracefully handles column absence.
Frontend ✅: AchievementsSection component (EvidenceTab.js lines 227-254) has correct data-testid='achievements-section' and data-testid='achievements-list'.
Frontend ✅: AchievementsSection returns null when achievements is empty/null — correct conditional rendering.
Frontend ✅: Emerald green styling (bg-emerald-50, border-emerald-200) and Star icons implemented correctly.
Frontend ✅: AchievementsSection rendered at line 371, between Meeting Summary and Pauses/Actions sections.
